description: This file defines the class FeedLogicBase, which provides base logic for handling feed-related hooks in the SuiteCRM system, including methods for pushing feeds and installing/removing hooks.

classes.name: FeedLogicBase
classes.description: A base class providing mechanisms to manage feed hooks within the module, including methods to push feeds and manage hook installation/removal.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: A placeholder method to handle pushing feed data for a given bean upon an event.

methods.name: installHook
methods.description: Sets up a logic hook for the 'before_save' event in the specified module, linking it to the pushFeed method.

methods.name: removeHook
methods.description: Removes a previously installed 'before_save' logic hook for the module related to push feed actions.
